title: Appointment of Judge of the High Court – Mark Andrew O’Regan
content:
10 November 2000

Appointment of Judge of the High Court – Mark Andrew O’Regan

  • Margaret Wilson
Attorney-General

The Attorney-General Margaret Wilson announced today the appointment of Mark O’Regan as a judge of the High Court.

Mr O’Regan graduated from Victoria University of Wellington and is a partner with Chapman Tripp.

He has practised primarily in the area of commercial law and Treaty of Waitangi settlement.

The new judge will be based in Auckland.
